Three block away there is a wrecking yard. There are people around a 66 pontiac GTO, both doors are open, they are putting in automatic Consoul inside. There is a semi driving down the street.The driver makes a turn, into the parking lot of the wrecking yard. the semi two trailers long makes a wide turn. The first trailer clears the car, the second one catches, THE back right fender and trunk With one set of tires. The second set catches the past side door, the trailer drives up and over the 66 pontiac GTO, the driver keeps on driving, turns right on the street, and keeps on going it 's, a black ken worth ,with eerie red glowing head lights. I have come for you, its time to pay a debt, sandy walking her son, in his baby stroller, watches the black semi, turning right with a man, on a bicycle right behind it. she gets out here cell phone, and calls the police, and reports a hit and run, Ten minutes laterThe police cars come.
